verdict.rationale: Maritime is a hosted cloud platform for AI agents, and whether its source is available under an open license is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the pack shows the platform, CLI or SDK source published under an open license. The public OpenAPI spec, Swagger UI and shareable templates are API descriptions and user content, not the product's source code, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
